1. (Currently amended) A method for providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the method comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information and the associated recipient data; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via __over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises at least one of: a certificate authorization code, an SMS message containing a URL link to a web page displaying a barcode, or a control SMS message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard coupon in the mobile device and wherein the electronic certificate selection information includes __data representing__ certificates selected by a user.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a certificate authorization code.

4. (Original) The method of claim 3 wherein the certificate authorization code includes an electronic coupon authorization code.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an __short message service (SMS) message containing a uniform resource locator (URL) link to a web page displaying a barcode__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control __short message service (SMS) message__ instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein establishing a communications link with a mobile device comprises: sending a control __short message service (SMS) message__ to the mobile device associated with the recipient data; and receiving, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data.

8. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising: storing the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device as a softcard coupon and personalization data.

9. (Original) The method of claim 8 further comprising: storing the personalization data within at least one of a secure element and mobile base band memory in the mobile device.

10. (Original) The method of claim 9 further comprising: communicating the personalization data to a wireless device reader in order to conduct a purchase transaction.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the certificate selection device includes at least one of a personal computer, a kiosk station, and a smart poster.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the mobile device comprises a first __near field communication (NFC) enabled device__, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second __near field communication (NFC) enabled mobile device__.

13. (Currently amended) A system for electronically providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, __wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises at least one of: a certificate authorization code, an SMS message containing a URL link to a web page displaying a barcode, or a control SMS message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon, and wherein the system further comprises a certificate selection device that generates the certificate selection information based on user interaction with at least one of a personal computer, a kiosk station, and a smart poster__.

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard electronic coupon in the mobile device and wherein the electronic certificate selection information includes __data representing__ certificates selected by a user.

15. (Original) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a certificate authorization code.

16. (Original) The system of claim 15 wherein the certificate authorization code includes an electronic coupon authorization code.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises an __short message service (SMS) message containing a uniform resource locator (URL) link to a web page displaying a barcode__.

18. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises a control __short message service (SMS) message__ instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon associated with the certificate selection information.

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to send a control __short message service (SMS) message__ to the mobile device associated with the recipient data, and receive, from the mobile device, an electronic value certificate download request for the electronic value certificate data.

20. (Original) The system of claim 13 wherein the OTA provisioning server is further configured to upload the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device as a softcard coupon and personalization data.

21. (Original) The system of claim 20 wherein the personalization data is provisioned to at least one of a secure element and mobile base band memory in the mobile device.

22. (Original) The system of claim 21 wherein the mobile device is adapted to communicate the personalization data to a wireless device reader in order to conduct a purchase transaction.

23. (Original) The system of claim 13 wherein the certificate selection device includes at least one of a personal computer, a kiosk station, and a smart poster.

24. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the mobile device comprises a first __near field communication (NFC) enabled device__, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second __near field communication (NFC) enabled mobile device__.

25. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory computer readable medium having stored thereon__ computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising: utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information; providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information and the associated recipient data; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, __wherein the electronic value certificate data comprises at least one of: a certificate authorization code, an SMS message containing a URL link to a web page displaying a barcode, or a control SMS message instructing the mobile device to download at least one barcode image of at least one coupon__.
